integrity: Every formula derived from the stated backward equations; independent published uniform-launch variance reconstructed symbolically; numerical root checks supplement an analytic one-crossing proof.
scientific_limitations: Strictly first-order Poisson restart response, with full state renewal and independent capture at each central crossing; no global positive-rate optimizer, other wall dynamics, or other velocity processes established.
title: A sharp spatial weak-resetting transition for partially reactive run-and-tumble search
